tools.name: search_finportal
tools.description: Use for a topic, event, or exact Macedonian Stock Exchange company name, curated alias, or ticker. Searches stored public MSE, SEI-Net, DZS, DZR, translated international, and FinPortal editorial/story records. Ticker matches and exact official results rank before broader text matches and recency. R

tools.name: get_latest_news
tools.description: Use for a concise feed of the most recent stored Macedonian business and international news. Results are saved snapshots, not a live feed, and retain attribution, FinPortal links, and original source links when available. When presenting news results to users, use the FinPortal.mk article URL in `ur

tools.name: get_domestic_news
tools.description: Use when the question concerns Macedonian public-company announcements or official statistics/audit releases. Filter by MSE, SEI-Net, DZS, or DZR; only public metadata already shown on FinPortal is returned. When presenting news results to users, use the FinPortal.mk article URL in `url` as the prim

tools.name: get_global_news
tools.description: Use for stored international financial news. Returns FinPortal's translated title and short translated summary with publisher, date, FinPortal URL, and original URL when available; never returns the original publisher's full text. When presenting news results to users, use the FinPortal.mk article U

tools.name: get_editorial_articles
tools.description: List original FinPortal editorial articles that are currently published. Use get_editorial_article with an ID or slug only when the full FinPortal-owned article is needed.

tools.name: get_editorial_article
tools.description: Retrieve the full body of one published, FinPortal-authored editorial article by ID or slug. This does not expose third-party articles or unpublished drafts.

tools.name: get_blog_story_summary
tools.description: Retrieve the public summary for a published FinPortal story by slug. Returns a short displayed excerpt and source link only; do not use it to retrieve third-party full text.

tools.name: get_daily_horoscope
tools.description: Return saved and published Macedonian daily horoscope content from FinPortal. Optionally select one zodiac sign or a service date; omit both to get today's prepared signs. Reads stored snapshots only and does not fetch or generate horoscope content on demand. Horoscope content is for entertainment,

tools.name: get_company_news
tools.description: Use for public news and editorial mentions of a company. Macedonian Stock Exchange issuers resolve by exact ticker, Cyrillic name, Latin transliteration, and curated aliases; pass company or ticker, and cite each returned source/date/URL. When presenting news results to users, use the FinPortal.mk a

tools.name: get_company_timeline
tools.description: Build a newest-first timeline of stored public mentions for a company or ticker. Use get_company_intelligence when a bounded date range and records grouped by source category are needed; this tool does not forecast price or performance. When presenting news results to users, use the FinPortal.mk art

tools.name: resolve_company
tools.description: Resolve a Macedonian Stock Exchange issuer from an exact ticker, Macedonian Cyrillic name, Latin transliteration, or curated alias. Returns candidates when an alias is ambiguous; it never guesses and does not return prices.

tools.name: get_company_intelligence
tools.description: Create a bounded, source-attributed evidence package for a Macedonian Stock Exchange issuer. Resolves Cyrillic/Latin names and ticker, filters stored filings, news, FinPortal editorial, public stories, and active public document metadata by date range, and groups results by source. Use for company r

tools.name: get_mse_announcements
tools.description: List stored Macedonian Stock Exchange announcement metadata with publication date and original link. Only the short description already displayed by FinPortal is returned, never the full third-party announcement. When presenting news results to users, use the FinPortal.mk article URL in `url` as the

tools.name: get_seinet_filings
tools.description: List stored SEI-Net public filing metadata with date and original link. Use this for issuer disclosure discovery; do not treat the excerpt as a complete filing. When presenting news results to users, use the FinPortal.mk article URL in `url` as the primary link. Retain the original publisher in `sou

tools.name: get_dzs_releases
tools.description: List stored State Statistical Office of Macedonia release metadata with date and original link. This tool does not expose full reports or calculate new statistics. When presenting news results to users, use the FinPortal.mk article URL in `url` as the primary link. Retain the original publisher in `

tools.name: get_dzr_reports
tools.description: List stored State Audit Office report metadata with date and source link. Use for public audit-report discovery; full third-party report text is not returned. When presenting news results to users, use the FinPortal.mk article URL in `url` as the primary link. Retain the original publisher in `sourc

tools.name: get_mvr_bulletins
tools.description: List recent public MVR bulletins already stored by FinPortal. Returns date, official source link, incident count, and short anonymized summaries; initials, ages, and identifying details are removed where recognized. Bulletin reports are not final court findings.

tools.name: get_jsp_routes
tools.description: Fetch the public Skopje bus routes from skopjebus.mk, grouped as city, regional, and night routes. Use the returned internal route ID with get_jsp_schedule; the line number is a separate display label.

tools.name: get_jsp_schedule
tools.description: Fetch planned departure times for a public Skopje bus route and date. Call get_jsp_routes first to resolve the route ID. This is a scheduled timetable, not real-time vehicle location or arrival prediction.

tools.name: get_source_policy
tools.description: Return the authoritative list of enabled data sources, exposed fields, source attribution, reuse restrictions, and disabled market-data categories. Check this before claiming that MCP provides quotes, indices, currency rates, or full third-party text.
